title: A field transition rebinds the current unmounted follower

verification.actor: One prepared FOLLOWER Cyndaquil with a verified live handle and attached presentation
verification.trigger: Use normal player input to complete one follower Walk, cross from Route29 into Cherrygrove, and take one recovery step
verification.observable: The actor owner advances field epoch and map generation once, emits CONTEXT_CHANGED then ACTOR_REBOUND, preserves the follower lifetime and current engine identity, and returns normal player control

setupMutations.change: Restore the saved slot-1 Cyndaquil and select it through the shared follower setup. This gives no motion, route, transition, or recovery credit.

limits: Covers one unmounted follower and one Route29-to-Cherrygrove boundary.
Does not prove mounted mid-motion rebind, indoor transitions, or long-run streaming.

events.value: Prepare and bind the saved slot-1 Cyndaquil follower
Walk the short normal route and observe one complete follower Walk
Cross the Cherrygrove field boundary and complete one recovery step
Observe the same follower lifetime with a current field handle and engine object

stop.condition: One map change, the follower has a current rebound handle, and the player settles one tile inside Cherrygrove

invariants: The bound follower completes one natural Walk before the transition
The field epoch and map generation each advance exactly once
The rebound follower retains its actor lifetime and subject identity
The rebound engine object belongs to the current map and manager
Normal player control completes one recovery step
